text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"འགྲོ་བའི་སྟོན་པ་ནི་ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་པའི་སྐུ་དག་སྟེ་བདག་ཉིད་ཡིན་པའོ། །","english":"\"The teacher of the wanderers\" refers to the two Sambhogakaya , which are the self.","kind":"number","why":"The source says 'Sambhogakaya' (plural/collective), but the English adds 'the two', which is not in the text.","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: "The teacher of the wanderers" refers to the two Sambhogakaya , which are the self.
contradictions.why: The source says 'Sambhogakaya' (plural/collective), but the English adds 'the two', which is not in the text.
